personas.background: Patience Park. Recently retired primary school teacher. Spent forty years caring for other people's children; now overwhelmed by having unstructured time. Loving but catastrophises minor family issues. Has become very active on the family chat since retirement — sometimes over-sharing.

food.value: will cook for any occasion; resists being told she doesn't need to cater for everything

activities.value: wants the whole family together for celebrations but gets overwhelmed by large organised events and prefers intimate gatherings she can control

preference_history.old_value: read the family chat but rarely posted; left responses to Imogen
preference_history.new_value: now very active — sends multiple messages a day, good-morning photos, recipe shares; retirement removed the professional boundary she used to maintain
preference_history.trigger: retired between sessions 0 and 1; with no school routine, the chat became her primary social outlet

speaking_quirks: sends good-morning messages with a sunrise photo
uses 'your father' to refer to Dad even when talking to him directly
adds 'just me?' when she's worried she's being too much

personas.background: Raymond Park. Accountant, still working three days a week. Quiet, measured. Has been quietly struggling since a minor health scare that he mentioned to no one in the family but Imogen noticed. Reads the chat but posts rarely — lets Patience handle the social fabric.

activities.value: prefers low-key family occasions; uncomfortable with fuss or large gatherings

social.value: lets Mum manage family logistics; inserts himself only when he disagrees with a direction

preference_history.old_value: would mention health concerns to Patience without delay
preference_history.new_value: had a minor cardiac event; told Imogen but not Patience; managing quietly to avoid worrying his wife
preference_history.trigger: cardiac scare in session 3; disclosed to Imogen but actively hid it from Patience and Kofi

speaking_quirks: posts in the chat with 'your mother and I' as a unit
signs messages with 'Dad' even on a phone
deflects personal questions with 'all fine here'

personas.background: Oldest child, lives in Toronto. Works in tech. Has the most distance from the family dynamics — physically and emotionally — but calls in for big moments. Financially comfortable but the cost of transatlantic travel means he can only realistically come home once a year. Feels guilt about this.

activities.value: can only realistically visit once a year; prioritises the summer visit; cannot always make Christmas due to Canadian winter travel

social.value: prefers low-key family time when he visits rather than big organised events

preference_history.old_value: open to a big family party for parents' anniversary
preference_history.new_value: opposes a big party partly because the cost and timing of travel from Toronto makes attendance difficult
preference_history.trigger: flights home during the proposed anniversary month are very expensive; Kofi can't justify another flight so soon after summer

speaking_quirks: calculates time zone when responding: 'just getting in — it's late here'
sends voice notes for emotional things
uses 'from my end' to describe his situation

personas.background: Youngest child, lives 20 minutes from the family home. Works in NHS administration. Manages most of the practical family logistics — doctors' appointments, repairs, shopping — without ever naming it as a burden. Noticed Dad's health issue and is carrying that quietly. Gets slightly worn down but presents as cheerful.

activities.value: handles most family admin and logistics quietly; does not seek credit and deflects when acknowledged

social.value: would welcome more involvement from Kofi in family logistics; doesn't say so directly

preference_history.old_value: managed logistics cheerfully without any reference to the load
preference_history.new_value: starting to show subtle exhaustion — occasional 'I'm on it' with a tired emoji; still not named as a problem
preference_history.trigger: Dad's health scare added to logistics load; Imogen is managing his appointment follow-ups on top of the usual

speaking_quirks: says 'already sorted' or 'I'm on it' before anyone asks who's doing logistics
deflects acknowledgments with 'of course, no problem'
adds a tired emoji (😴) to messages more often in later sessions

edges.history_summary: 40-year marriage. Patience manages the social fabric; Raymond lets her. He is protective of her and concealing his health situation to avoid worry.
Patience is proud of Kofi and missing him. She calls him regularly.
Imogen is nearby and involved. Patience relies on Imogen for logistics without fully acknowledging how much.
Raymond is proud of Kofi. The physical distance makes them phone-call close but not day-to-day. Raymond disclosed nothing about his health to Kofi.
Raymond is closest to Imogen — she is nearby and he trusts her discretion. He disclosed his cardiac scare to her alone.
shared_events: Dad disclosed health scare to Imogen only

edges.history_summary: Close siblings, but Imogen carries the daily family load while Kofi lives abroad. They love each other deeply, and the guilt/resentment edge sometimes sits underneath that closeness.

group_norms.norm_text: Everyone comes home for Christmas — no exceptions.
Family decisions (big ones) get discussed in the chat before any external plans are made.
No sharing family health or personal news outside the chat without checking first.
